authority.definition: Ryan McGovern's centralized, public, opt-in Neobrutalism design system
not_primary_success_metrics: minimum product CSS at all costs

contract.normative_clause: exactly one force and at least one provenance
contract.descriptive_assertion: at least one provenance and no implied requirement

opt_in.rule: Do not reset or take over bare elements.
Apply no visual effect without an opt-in class or configured scope.
Installation or import alone does not adopt Neobrutalism.
Consumers may remove Neobrui classes and mappings while preserving semantic HTML and application behavior.

visual_language.rule: Establish strong visible hierarchy before decoration.
Use bold compact display and label typography while keeping body reading calm.
Use thick meaningful boundaries and hard unblurred offset shadows on focal surfaces.
Make focus and applicable interaction states obvious without relying on shadow alone.
Use high-energy palettes bounded by semantic roles.
Default to square or small-radius geometry.

intentional_irregularity.rule: Vary span, size, alignment, rhythm, and emphasis according to content hierarchy; keep it structured and purposeful.
Do not use equal-card walls as the default, random offsets, meaning-changing CSS reordering, or overflow-causing overlap.
Preserve meaningful source and task order and narrow-width reflow.
At narrow widths remove ornamental offsets, reduce large gaps and shadows, and preserve action/result proximity.

restraint.rule: Do not give every element a border, shadow, accent, uppercase text, or motion.
Identify hierarchy and focal surfaces before decorative treatment.
Keep 30-50% of visible regions quiet, unframed, rule-only, or low-chroma.

shadow.rule: Default to logical down-and-inline-end shadow and press direction.
A product with physical light-source intent may scope fixed down-right shadows.
Keep rest offset, active translation, and shadow collapse on the same direction/sign convention.
Keep focus independent and suppress nonessential translation under reduced motion.

product_identity.rule: Product identity and explicit brief override Neobrui defaults and recipe examples.
Accessibility and native semantics override Neobrui visual principles.

system_model.principles: Canonical prose rules and good/bad examples
system_model.foundations: Directly authored semantic CSS custom properties

tools.utilities_later_gate: Only truly one-job signature helpers with two-consumer evidence

system_model.ai_contract: Condensed rules, examples, anti-examples, lookup, decision procedure, and verification

html_day_pilot_evidence.verdict: INVALIDATED broad standalone utility ownership for the tested slice

verification.caveat: One mobile-Chrome gutter test failed in the full run and passed only when rerun in isolation; the pilot records it as unrelated to Step 3 controls and non-reproducing in isolation.

inference.rule: Do not make broad utility ownership the default; utilities remain valid for one-job accessibility helpers and proven repeated signature helpers, while coordinated interaction states belong in a primitive.

required: one representative full multi-engine gallery matrix

ai_ingestion.trigger: Use when an explicit brief asks for Neobrui or Ryan's Neobrutalist design language; do not apply by default.
